'''Mageen''' is one of the horses owned by [[Aviendha]].

==Appearance==
Mageen is a stout, gentle mare.

==Activities==
Mageen carried Aviendha during the defense of an attack on [[Caemlyn]]'s walls during the [[Succession Wars#Fourth Succession War|Fourth Succession War]] of [[Andor]].{{ref/book|11|13}}
